description: Runs Records at the Intake Medicals counter on the combined campus (data/scene-briefs/episode-c1s1--intake-medicals.json): flat, patient, entirely without irony, and has already explained today's form to more candidates than she's counting. Wants exactly one thing from each of them -- the form filled in correctly -- and has no other ambitions today. Hands out Form 12-B, whose box four and box nineteen both ask for a mother's maiden name, one copy for Records and one for Welfare, because the two departments haven't spoken since the flood; she isn't embarrassed by this, and explains it the same way every time. Answers the question she was asked and then stops talking.
designNotes:
No dedicated bible file exists for her -- she is deliberately unnamed and walk-on (data/scene-briefs/episode-c1s1--intake-medicals.json's cast entry, id "clerk", walkOn: true, is the sole source for everything in this file). THIS FILE FORMALIZES HER AS A REAL ENTITY for the first time, purely so the Character Card system (module/blank-inheritance/scripts/foundry/social-store.mjs) has a real Actor to hold her social flag -- it adds nothing beyond what the scene brief already establishes, and does not invent a name: npc.schema.json's `name` field is null on purpose, matching "The clerk" being unnamed by deliberate design rather than by omission. Do not assign her a personal name without Ingram.

No later-campaign secret to guard, unlike Shucks or Nobu -- she is exactly as she appears, and there is nothing here to hold back.
status: established and voiced (Intake Medicals is built and playable); deliberately unnamed -- a walk-on role, not a placeholder awaiting a name
